deviations: 03: vc=1 is no longer 'last' (amended as the packet said); the grammar line gains [|aw=1].

Drive: the graph's vacant flag flips at the beat, but the planet's view takes its new stage when the piece lands (R11), about a second later. Polling for 'not vacant' therefore fired too early and the burst missed the sweep. The step polls Kit's tint for its first lift instead, and spaces the burst 90 ms apart so 8 stills cover ~1 s. The step also scans from schedule 0, because Kit is already holding at the first beat.
Drive's first-arrival scan checks both seats of Lantern Pod; here it found Kit.
No perf run: the change adds a uniform branch only, no pass or filter.
limitations: Keystone not run and solar e2e not run clean (see checks). Orchestrator should re-run e2e:keystone and solar.spec.ts when the machine is quieter.

I once ran git stash in the shared tree to get a solar baseline; it held other agents' uncommitted edits (docs/progress/v1.4/ledger.jsonl, C2 work) for about 25 minutes before the pop restored everything (status after the pop matched, ledger.jsonl modified, stash list empty). Anyone who saw files vanish in that window should re-check.
A test hook for first light was not added (out of scope); the drive reads it through the seat's tint.
Stills are 160 px clips at device scale; the planet in Kit's Haven is a volcanic line, so the pinpoints read mainly as a warm bloom over the lit crescent rather than a clean night-side front.
